title: Uniqueness of the prescribed integral Roos limit
statement: For a normalized DVR tower T and an integral constructible object M satisfying IntegralDualizingLimitPresentation l E D hl X T M.obj, the presented object M.obj is isomorphic to the chosen derived limit (integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower.

proof.text: For the arbitrary supplied strict tower, apply the specification of the published total derived inverse limit to a complex representing it. Compare the auxiliary evaluation with normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation using its factorization through cochain localization. Naturality and the formula for Localization.liftNatTrans identify the successor transitions. Form the product isomorphism from the evaluation isomorphisms and transport the distinguished triangle to the published integralOperationsDerivedCountableProducts witness. This yields a Roos triangle for (integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower with exactly the evaluation transitions of the presentation.

Unpack hM to obtain its maps p and delta and its Roos triangle, ignoring the additional counit and compatibility clauses. Apply the uniqueness clause of exists_isDerivedLimit_and_iso to these two derived limits of the same tower. This theorem rotates the triangles, extends the identity arrow isomorphism and unshifts the resulting third-object isomorphism.
